svg.title: Compact candidate: full Hankel multiplier with dual two-path passive accumulators
svg.desc: Proposed functional SiN and thin-film lithium-niobate photonic integrated circuit on a silicon substrate. A held input comb in band A mixes with a tap of pump-band coefficient memory in DFG 1, is filtered in band B, mixes with shared b in DFG 2, and is filtered back into band A. Two whole-comb electro-optic Mach-Zehnder cells route alternating coefficient frames into two fixed 70-tap weighted two-path delay networks and select a valid window. There is no output shutter: raw partial-sum light remains outside the acceptance window of the receiving nonlinear stage. Each lattice has eight two-path cells, five balanced and three weighted, with component delays from 10 to 200 picoseconds. The compact 400-picosecond frame schedule is a candidate that requires optically formatted pump bursts confined to the 390-picosecond completed plateau; 35 picoseconds of margin remain on each side of the useful 320-picosecond window. A separate write-mode panel reuses DFG 1 and its band-B filter, then adds one cross-SFG and pump-band filtering for optical coefficient updates. All read and write modes are scheduled separately; dual accumulators do not imply concurrent writing. External comb generation, data encoding, optical replay and recirculating fiber memory are explicit. Functional candidate only, not a scaled or fabricated layout. Pump-edge and filter-settling requirements have not been validated.

g.text: One spatial lane on a hybrid SiN / thin-film LN PIC · functional design, not a scaled floorplan
aₘ stays in pump band P; only a read tap enters the core
Persistent fiber path bypasses computation and is reinjected
Hold x = k or q during the R coefficient slots
Supply optical v, e and replayed k for update mode
bₘ: fixed envelope + scheduled spectral phase ramps
Amortized across the array; distribution power is budgeted
Outside the drawn PIC or co-packaged: source lasers, encoders, long fiber storage, key / residual replay, timing electronics.
READER · two fixed nonlinear sections, followed by an electrically scheduled passive accumulator
Read x = k to predict; read x = q after coefficient writes commit. All lines of each comb share each optical path.
Same fixed network; staggered coefficient frames
Field sum / 70 during the completed plateau
ŷ = Σ zₘ / 70 within accepted window
Partial sums remain outside that window
Timed coefficient pump + DFG + B filter
Accept useful field; reject unconverted light
Two active EO cells route the accumulator. No output shutter; pump, replay and memory acceptance remain scheduled interfaces.
OPTIONAL COEFFICIENT WRITER · compact reuse of DFG 1 in separate time windows
DFG 1 and its B filter are reused. Residual capture, replay and coefficient injection must accept only valid time windows.
e = v − ŷ, in band A
Replayed k in A + rₘ in B
Coherent injection into gated aₘ in P
Physical nonlinear count: 2 DFG + 1 cross-SFG with reuse. Dedicated error DFG is an optional fourth section.
Predict → form / replay residual → write all coefficient slots → query. Dual read filters do not establish simultaneous read / write operation.
FUNCTIONAL MATERIAL REGIONS ON A SILICON SUBSTRATE · placement and dimensions remain to be designed
Broadband phase matching; distinct A, B, P ports
SiN routing + two nested delay networks
103.5 mm differential path per lattice at τ = 10 ps, n_g = 2
207 mm across both lattices; excludes common paths and bends
Two accumulator cells + local timing / bias
Slow trim of fixed lattice phases as needed
No pump-band frequency translator. P-band paths must use suitable LN / SiN; ordinary telecom silicon routing is not assumed.
